'''Qiina''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the years following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformation]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Qiina was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], serving as a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the decade following the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] that swept through the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] and the Order. Ten years following the end of the [[New Sith Wars]], Master Qiina resided within the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and enjoyed long days of study in the [[Jedi Archives/Legends|Temple Archives]] maintained by [[Chief Librarian/Legends|Chief Librarian]] [[Barra-Rona-Ban]].<ref name="RoT" /> Having studied as a [[Jedi Consular|Consular]], Master Qiina was a learned [[Lore Keeper]] and specialized as a [[Jedi librarian/Legends|librarian]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

During one day in the Archives, Master Qiina unknowingly sat a few meters from one of the two existing [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lords of the Sith]], [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]]. The Sith, posing as [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Nalia Adollu]], sat at a nearby terminal studying the ways in which to remove the deadly [[orbalisk]]s which plagued her master, [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]]. Qiina became openly annoyed when Zannah and her cousin [[Darovit]], who were both trying to look up the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] to the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], started making too much noise in their haste to leave before Darovit could be questioned about his knowledge of Zannah and her master.<ref name="RoT" />

Not minutes after the cousins left, Master Qiina, at the request of Master [[Valenthyne Farfalla]], pointed out which terminal the cousins were using. After finding out where they were going, Farfalla organized a group of Jedi to follow them to Tython. There, he and the group were killed by the Sith Lords Bane and Zannah.<ref name="RoT" />
